course_name_original: Expresión gráfica y diseño asistido por ordenador ii (20224002)
course_name_en: Graphical expression and computer-aided design ii
prerequisites: Graphical expression and computer-aided design I (20224001)

learning_outcomes.text: Applies correctly spatial vision and graphical representation techniques, both by traditional methods of metric and descriptive geometry, and by computer-aided design applications.
Knows standardization bodies and their products. Interprets and uses technical drawings and catalogs. Creates assemblies and exploded views of mechanisms and products. Masters 2D and 3D CAD systems.

Masters the tools for managing one's own identity and activities in a digital environment (being digital). Searches for and obtains information autonomously according to reliability and relevance criteria (searching). Organizes information with appropriate tools, online or in-person, that allow the development of academic activities (organizing). Prepares information with the appropriate tools and formats for the communicative situation and does so honestly (creating). Uses ICT to share and exchange information (sharing).

syllabus_topics: Gears and turning systems: Standardization, representation and representation
Representation of assemblies with movement and special parts
Boilermaking and piping: Principles and criteria for the resolution of intersections and developments
CAD.3D: Computer tools for modeling volumes and parts
Integrated course project: Resolution of an integrated project as a summary of the course
teaching_methods: Introductory activities: Presentation and introduction to course operations
Lecture session: Combination of lecture and case study through the introduction of basic concepts. Joint discussion of examples and exercise completion.
Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom: Students solve problem sets under the supervision of the teacher.
ICT-based practices: Solving practices with computer tools, assessable in class.
Assignments: Specialization application work, summary and compendium of concepts explained in class.
Personalized attention: Student support hours in the office. Personalized resolution of exercises in the classroom.
assessment_rules: To pass the course in the first attempt, all conceptual groups, all tests, and all assignments must be passed; averaging between conceptual groups, practices, or deliveries is not allowed. Failure to submit mandatory assignments results in a zero grade. For the second attempt, all conceptual groups must also be passed without averaging, and favorable aspects from the first attempt may be considered. Evaluation tests consist of a conceptual test (Moodle) and a practical part; a minimum score of 4/10 on the conceptual test is mandatory to proceed with the practical exercises.
